description.text: The course aims to educate students to study basic theory and elementary knowledge in medicine, gain basic clinical skills of some common diseases diagnosis processing, have the primary treatment ability to urgent, difficult and severe symptoms, and be qualified for careers in hospitals, the medical and health units, medical science research departments as well as other organizations related medicine.

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Tongji University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3986 USD/per year ￥ 28700 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above
